title: OpenCues cue.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a cue.md file. Spec: opencues/0.1-alpha. See /spec/cue-spec.md.

name.description: Unique identifier for this cue source. Lowercase, hyphens permitted.

description.description: Human-readable summary. NOT a trigger. Validators warn when absent.

match.description: ECMA regex. Word matches if the regex matches it (case-insensitive by default).

keywords.description: Word matches if it (case-insensitively) equals any keyword.

model.description: Override the runtime's default model for this source.

scope.description: Where this source applies. Inferred from path; explicit only when overriding.

type.description: Discriminator for shared directories. Inferred from path; usually omitted.

on-host.description: Allow-list of host names that may load this source.
